Deletion of Your Online shop Has Been Scheduled For October 14 ,2026, reply
STOP to this mail to get connected to the required assistance needed for
your store continued and successful operation.
Handed to the team · Suspected phishing / social engineering attempt against the store, not a shopper

Note to the team: This one isn't a customer message, it's a phishing attempt. The "your shop has been scheduled for deletion, reply STOP" format is a standard scare template.
